content.comment_body: Hello, I installed a [product_name] (version [version_no]) with an ATC1000 interface and I'm trying to read Modbus variables from a Lovato DMG110 instrument, but I'm not having any success.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English language forum, so please write your future posts in English. Thank you.
Are you certain the ATC-1000 settings are configured correctly?

The ATC1000 protocol list includes ICMP, IP, TCP, UDP, DHCP, BOOTP, Telnet, DNS, HTTP, and ARP. There does not appear to be support for Modbus TCP/IP. Consider changing your interface and review the supported protocols carefully before making a purchase. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to connect a [product_name] ([version_no]) to a third-party Modbus instrument through an ATC1000 interface, but is unable to read variables. Other users point out that the ATC1000 does not support Modbus TCP/IP protocol, which is necessary for communication, highlighting a protocol compatibility mismatch between the automation device and the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] ([version_no]) to communicate successfully with a Modbus meter via ATC1000 and retrieve variable data.
